label: Школа
description: Twelve-mission case drill for школа (school) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.phrase: Наша школа стоит рядом с парком.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form школа is the subject of стоит. First-declension feminine nouns in -а keep this bare ending in the nominative singular, naming who or what acts.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. After the preposition из marking motion out of, школа becomes школы. Hard feminines take the genitive singular ending -ы.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. After the preposition по expressing movement around, школа appears as школе. The dative singular ending for first-declension feminines is -е.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of построил takes the accusative школу, where nominative -а becomes -у. Being inanimate, школа uses this dedicated -у form.
Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, so школа becomes школой. The instrumental singular ending for hard feminines is -ой.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. After в marking location inside, школа takes the prepositional школе. The prepositional singular ending -е coincides with the dative for first-declension feminines.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural subject is школы, where singular -а changes to the plural ending -ы. This -ы marks the nominative plural of hard feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. Hard feminines drop the vowel in the genitive plural, leaving the zero-ending form школ. The negation нет plus genitive triggers it here.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The verb помогать governs the dative, so the plural ending -ам gives школам, the recipient of help. The -ам ending is uniform for hard feminine plurals.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Because школа is inanimate, the accusative plural copies the nominative plural школы rather than the genitive. The direct object of открывают stays школы.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, so the plural ending -ами produces школами. This -ами ending is regular across hard feminine nouns.

missions.phrase: В этих школах учатся тысячи детей.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. After в indicating location, the prepositional plural ending -ах gives школах. This ending is constant for hard feminines in the prepositional plural.
